comment: The battle rules on one fixture (two party members, two enemies, FIGHTSTG.PRO in the slot, SDIGIEDT.PRO as the enemy records). Techniques: 1 and 10 basic (kind 1, power 60/100), 150 Ice elemental (defense_stat 4, element_power 32), 225 (defense_stat 6), 131 (strong type), 55 (anim script 0xB), 230 (kind 2), 72 (kind 9, elemental), 403 (kind 0xB, elemental). Side 0 is the party attacking enemy 0, side 1 enemy 0 attacking member 0. Each case is one call; its own writes change the fixture first. Reads: fightstg_rules.stats[2], pad_random.index (draws taken), fightstg_battle.state when the call changes it.
